title: A vanillin bio-based redox polymer as a cathode material for lithium organic batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00349K, Paper
Tijs Lap, Gabriele Lingua, Daniele Mantione, David Mecerreyes
This work illustrates a scalable synthetic route to a bio-based catechol polymer from vanillin to be used as a high-voltage organic electrode material in batteries.
